headline: WARSH FACES DEBUT JACKSON HOLE TEST AS PCE HITS 3.7% — Gold Slips to $4,648 With Rate-Hold Odds Rising to 60% Ahead of Friday Keynote
snippet: Gold spot dipped to $4,648.90 on Thursday as July's PCE came in at 3.7% — above the 3.6% consensus — trimming a three-session advance and pushing rate-hold odds to 60%. Markets are squaring positions ahead of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote on Friday, which will be closely watched for any signal on whether persistent inflation warrants a pause or hike.

headline: Q2 METALS DRILLS BEST HOLE IN CISCO HISTORY — 678 of 803 Metres Mineralized at 1.57% Li₂O as James Bay Pegmatite Keeps Growing
snippet: Q2 Metals (TSXV: QTWO) reported hole CS26-093 at the Cisco Lithium Project in Quebec returned 403.7 metres at 1.57% Li₂O and 213.8 metres at 1.93% Li₂O — covering 678 of a total 803-metre hole. VP Exploration Sage McCallum called it 'the best hole ever drilled on Cisco in terms of total mineralized pegmatite in one hole,' with a 2026 Fall resource update pending.

headline: SOUTHERN CROSS GOLD EXTENDS RISING SUN TO 886m DEPTH — 1,466 g/t AuEq in Deepest-Ever Sunday Creek Hole Sends SXGC to TSX Top Gainers
snippet: Southern Cross Gold (TSX: SXGC | ASX: SX2) drilled 0.3 metres at 1,466.7 g/t AuEq from 886.7 metres at its Sunday Creek gold-antimony project in Victoria, Australia — the fourth-highest individual assay in project history and the deepest confirmed west-to-east intercept under Rising Sun. The result lifted SXGC 6% to top the TSX gainers list; 76 additional holes are awaiting assay.

headline: RACKLA METALS DOUBLES DRILLING AT LENTUNG AS SCHEELITE HITS ALL FIVE HOLES — Second RC Rig Accelerates 10,000-Metre Tungsten Campaign in NWT
snippet: Rackla Metals (TSXV: RAK) added a second reverse-circulation rig to its Lentung tungsten project in Northwest Territories, targeting 10,000 total metres in 2026. Scheelite mineralization — identified by UV fluorescence — has been intersected in all five diamond holes drilled to date in the Central Zone; first lab assays are being shipped this week. Lentung was last drilled by Union Carbide in 1982.

headline: 51,978 COUNTS PER SECOND: XCITE URANIUM'S FIRST DON LAKE HOLES RETURN PEAK RADIOACTIVITY — 14-Hole Program Advancing Near Uranium City, Saskatchewan
snippet: Eagle Plains Resources and partner Xcite Uranium (CSE: XRI) reported that the first three drillholes at Don Lake, Saskatchewan returned a peak handheld scintillometer reading of 51,978 counts per second across multiple zones of anomalous radioactivity. The 1,500-metre, 14-hole program targets structurally-controlled uranium mineralization near Uranium City; chemical assays are pending and required to establish grades.

headline: COPPER NEAR $6.59/LB AS ZIJIN WARNS KAMOA-KAKULA FLOODING MAY COST 57,000 TONNES — 2026 Refined Deficit Now Tracking 600,000 Tonnes
snippet: Zijin Mining warned that flood-related disruptions at the Kamoa-Kakula complex in the DRC could reduce its copper output by up to 57,000 tonnes in 2026, compounding Ivanhoe's earlier 22.5% production guidance cut. With copper spot at $6.57–$6.59 per pound — up 47% year-over-year — J.P. Morgan now projects a 330,000-tonne refined shortfall for the year, with Citigroup targeting $15,000/tonne within 12 months.

headline: GOLD MINERS TRADE AT SINGLE-DIGIT P/Es AS GOLD HOLDS $4,600 — Analysts Flag 15 Low-Hanging Fruit Names With Operational Leverage to Metal Price
snippet: With gold above $4,600 and all-in sustaining costs far below spot prices, analysts argue gold and silver producers are trading at anomalously low multiples — some in the single digits — despite near-record margins. The piece identifies 15 names where operational leverage to the gold price remains underpriced relative to producer cash flows, with a notable emphasis on mid-tier Canadian names.

headline: STICKY PCE FORCES RATE-CUT RETHINK ACROSS COMMODITY MARKETS — Dollar Firms as Mining and Energy Equities Recalibrate Before Warsh Speaks
snippet: July's PCE inflation print of 3.7% — a tenth above consensus — firmed the U.S. dollar and trimmed rate-cut expectations across risk assets including mining stocks. With Fed Chair Warsh scheduled to speak Friday in Jackson Hole for the first time since taking office in May, commodity-linked equities are holding positions cautiously as markets wait for clarity on the policy path.

headline: TECK MAILS TRANSMITTAL LETTERS AS $53B ANGLO-TECK COPPER MERGER CLEARS FINAL BONDHOLDER STEPS — China Approval the Last Gate
snippet: Teck Resources has mailed letters of transmittal to shareholders in connection with its merger of equals with Anglo American, the penultimate step in forming Anglo Teck plc — a combined copper giant targeting a September 2026 to March 2027 closing. The $53 billion all-stock deal cleared bondholder consent hurdles in August and has its executive leadership team in place; China's final regulatory approval is the remaining gate.
